newsitem.title: USA: Ginnie Mae adds $300 million to REMIC 1997-04.
newsitem.headline: Ginnie Mae adds $300 million to REMIC 1997-04.

text.p: The Government National Mortgage Association (Ginnie Mae or GNMA) said it increased to $720 million a previous issue of Real Estate Mortgage Investment Conduit (REMIC) securities.
An additional $300 million of 7.5-percent GNMA I paper was added to REMIC 1997-04, according to a GNMA press release.

Formerly backed by $220 million of 7.0-percent GNMA II certificates and $200 million of 7.5-percent GNMA I certificates, the REMIC now totals $720 million, according to GNMA and sponsor Greenwich Capital Markets Inc.
The issue priced on February 11, was most recently increased on February 27 and has a settlement date of March 28, GNMA said.
Pryor McClendon Counts & Co co-sponsored the issue, the agency said.
